thread:
mira: quick spike question — autoswitch fallback UX: do we show which degrade mode kicked in (silent vs graceful vs hard)?
mira: Ops wants immediate context in the rollout timeline.
ojas: yes, show mode + reason code inline. e.g., 'graceful: latency_threshold' with a link to the policy rule.
tony: +1. also surface the exact trigger (latency_ms > 1200 / token_oom / model_mismatch) so SREs can triage quickly.
mira: for audit we need a compact sample that allows replay without saving full prompts by default. proposal: store prompt_hash, kv_keys, model_variant, fallback_mode, reason_code, policy_id, trace_id.
security-bot: reminder: payload capture must be opt-in per-tenant. default: payload off, ids hashed, retention 7d. need explicit tenant consent for longer.
ojas: UX idea: in the rollout timeline each fallback event has a small chevron that expands to show the sampled metadata and a "replay in sandbox" button (disabled if payload not captured).
ton y: backend detail — sampling decision must be made before expensive decode/tokenize. return header X-Fallback-Sample: decision_id|sampled=1|rate=0.01|reason=latency_high so downstream stores only when needed.
mira: good. also add an "explain" link that opens the policy editor and highlights the rule that fired. reduces context switching.
ojas: cost control — per-policy sample budget (e.g., 5k traces/month) rather than only percent. helps teams with predictable billing. console shows burn gauge.
ton y: agree. convert budget -> dynamic rate given recent QPS. also support emergency snapshot that captures N traces immediately (admin-only, with TTL).
security-bot: emergency snapshot must require 2 approvals for tenants with strict compliance. flag in audit trail who triggered it.
mira: we should support adaptive hysteresis to avoid thrashing: require M failures in T seconds to escalate sampling and hold for min_duration. show hysteresis config inline.
ojas: proto/config sketch for console folks:
```yaml
policy_id: p-auto-1
rules:
  - id: r-latency
    match: response.latency_ms > 1200
    fallback: graceful_degrade
    sampling:
      mode: budget
      monthly_budget_traces: 5000
      baseline_rate: 0.0005
      adaptive:
        failures_for_bump: 10
        window_s: 60
        bump_rate: 0.05
        min_bump_duration_s: 300
      include_payload: false
      allow_emergency_snapshot: true
```
ton y: metrics we'll emit: audit.sample.accepted, audit.sample.dropped_quota, audit.sample.effective_rate, fallback.mode.count. these feed the rollout timeline panels.
ojas: UI microcopy: when include_payload=false, show "Replay using hashed snapshot (no PII)" and when true show "Replay with payload (encrypted)". clear about data sensitivity.
mira: edgecase: multi-variant fallbacks — if request falls back across 2 variants in sequence, we should link the chain in the timeline and include the sequence in sampled metadata.
ton y: implementation note: sampling decision must include the full decision path: [variant_small_v1 -> variant_tiny_v2] so replay can step through. store as decision_trace.
ops-bot: scheduled probe: autoswitch-sample-burn-1757 at 2024-10-11T03:30:00Z. will post results and sample counts.
security-bot: opened ticket SEC-4521: define redaction + KMS envelope defaults for sampled payloads.
mira: next steps: Ojas — mock the timeline expanders and budget gauge. Tony — spec header and decision_trace proto. Security — finalise retention defaults. I'll draft an RFC and include sample timeline mock.
ojas: will post Figma link later today.
ton y: will PR the header contract.
security-bot: will add checklist to SEC-4521.
mira: great. reconvene after probe. :white_check_mark:
